name: Rebuild a whole page as Shopify theme sections with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole page as Shopify theme sections with MiroMiro

### How it works
Rebuild every section of a web page as Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme sections. **Extract Hero and Find Sections** loads the page from **Set Website URL** in a real browser, rebuilds the hero and lists every other section. **Extract Each Section as Shopify** rebuilds each one as a `.liquid` section with its schema, styled like the original, and the files are zipped in page order. A section that fails is skipped and counted in `failed`, so one bad section does not stop the run. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Hero and Find Sections** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Select the same credential in **Extract Each Section as Shopify**.
5. Set your page in **Set Website URL** and click **Execute workflow**.
6. Download the zip from **Zip the Liquid Sections**. In Shopify: Online Store > Themes > Edit code > sections, add each file, then add the sections in the theme editor.

Each section costs 10 credits, so a page of 6 to 12 sections is 60 to 120. The same page again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Upload each file straight into a theme with an HTTP Request node and the Shopify Admin API (see the "Rebuild a section in your Shopify theme" template). Test on an unpublished theme copy. The text and images belong to the source site: replace them unless it is yours.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/rebuild-whole-page-as-shopify-sections.png)

nodes.name: Save Each Section as Liquid File

parameters.content:
## Choose the page

Put the page to rebuild in **Set Website URL**.

## Find the sections

The first call rebuilds the hero and lists every other section on the page, in order.

## Rebuild and zip

Each section becomes a .liquid theme section. A failed section is skipped and counted; the rest are zipped.
